case_name: Case 24: Add Agenda Slide After First

history.IF_reason: The agent correctly inserted a new slide immediately after the title slide with the title 'Agenda' and all requested section headings, item numbers, titles, and descriptions, with only minor extra template/sidebar text such as 'AGENDA' and '00' beyond the requested content.
history.prompt:
After the title slide, add a new slide titled 'Agenda'. The agenda should list these three sections:

Section 1:
02. Founding Story: Origin and background.
03. Mission: Core purpose and goals.
04. Values: Shared beliefs and principles.

Section 2: Tools
06. Communication: Channels and protocols.
08. Design: Design standards and aesthetics.

Section 3: Process
10. Time: Scheduling, deadlines, and management.
11. Feedback: Guidelines for giving and receiving input.
